title: Engenheiro de Análise Oceânica III
description:
Quem somos

A Longitude Engineering, parte do ABL Group, é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia especializada nos setores marítimo, naval, energia, offshore e renováveis.

Atuamos globalmente apoiando clientes ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos complexos, com foco em segurança, excelência técnica, inovação e sustentabilidade.

No Brasil, nossa equipe trabalha de forma integrada com times internacionais, conectando expertise local ao know-how global do grupo.

Nossa missão, visão e valores

Missão

Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com alto padrão técnico e segurança.

Visão

Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade técnica, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

Valores

  • Safety First – Segurança sempre em primeiro lugar
  • Technical Excellence – Qualidade e precisão técnica
  • Collaboration – Trabalho em equipe e relações de confiança
  • Innovation – Melhoria contínua e soluções inteligentes
  • Integrity & Transparency – Ética, clareza e responsabilidade

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Análise Oceânica Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de análises técnicas e modelagens numéricas no departamento de Engenharia Oceânica da Longitude.

Este profissional participará de estudos de engenharia relacionados a hidrodinâmica, sistemas de ancoragem, instalações submarinas e operações marítimas , contribuindo para a execução segura e eficiente de projetos offshore.

A posição envolve a realização de simulações computacionais, análise de resultados, elaboração de relatórios técnicos e suporte técnico a operações offshore , com eventual participação em atividades embarcadas ou acompanhamento de operações quando necessário.

O profissional atuará em um ambiente técnico e multidisciplinar, interagindo com diferentes disciplinas de engenharia e colaborando em projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver análises de sistemas de ancoragem para unidades offshore (FPSO, plataformas e embarcações).
  • Realizar modelagens e simulações numéricas utilizando softwares como OrcaFlex e OrcaWave .
  • Avaliar condições ambientais, carregamentos e comportamento de sistemas submarinos com base em dados meteocean .
  • Conduzir análises hidrodinâmicas relacionadas ao comportamento de embarcações e equipamentos offshore.
  • Automatizar processos de análise e tratamento de dados utilizando Python quando aplicável.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e documentação de engenharia.
  • Dar suporte técnico a operações marítimas e subsea quando necessário.
  • Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares em projetos de engenharia offshore.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de metodologias e ferramentas de análise.

Requisitos

  • ✔ Graduação em Engenharia Naval, Oceânica, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas .
  • ✔ Experiência com modelagem e simulação no software OrcaFlex .
  • ✔ Experiência em análises de sistemas de ancoragem, linhas ou instalação submarina .
  • ✔ Capacidade de interpretação de resultados de simulações e elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
  • ✔ Inglês intermediário para leitura técnica e comunicação profissional.
  • ✔ Experiência prévia em projetos de engenharia offshore.

Diferenciais

  • ⭐ Experiência em hidrodinâmica aplicada ao movimento de embarcações .
  • ⭐ Experiência com operações marítimas ou engenharia operacional offshore .
  • ⭐ Conhecimento em análise de linhas, cabos, risers ou lançamento de equipamentos submarinos .
  • ⭐ Conhecimento em normas e regulatórios como DNV, ABS, API 2SK ou CSS Code .
  • ⭐ Experiência com softwares como Rhino, HydroD, OrcaWave, Lashcon, Inventor ou Optimoor .
  • ⭐ Experiência com outros softwares de análise hidrodinâmica.

Habilidades técnicas

  • Modelagem e simulação offshore utilizando OrcaFlex .
  • Análise de sistemas de ancoragem e linhas submarinas.
  • Interpretação de resultados de simulações hidrodinâmicas.
  • Avaliação de condições ambientais (meteocean).
  • Elaboração de relatórios técnicos de engenharia.
  • Programação em Python para automação de análises.
  • Conhecimento em hidrodinâmica aplicada a operações offshore.

Habilidades comportamentais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico .
  • Autonomia para conduzir análises técnicas complexas.
  • Boa comunicação técnica e trabalho em equipe.
  • Proatividade na busca por soluções de engenharia.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes técnicos.
  • Capacidade de orientar estagiários e engenheiros júnior.

Como é trabalhar na Longitude

Ambiente técnico, colaborativo e multicultural.

Interação constante com equipes e projetos internacionais.

Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e crescimento dentro do grupo.

Participação em projetos relevantes nos setores marítimo, offshore e de energia.

title: Statistician — Time-Series Insights Writer (AI Training)
description:
We’re seeking Statisticians with strong English writing skills to join our Deep Research for Forecasting project. In this role, you will review time-series plots (a quantity of interest over time) along with brief contextual descriptions, then identify the most meaningful patterns in the data and produce concise, well-reasoned causal chains explaining what likely drove those patterns.

Your work will help create high-quality tasks used to train and evaluate AI systems on forecasting-related reasoning. You will focus on distinguishing signal from noise, articulating plausible mechanisms (root cause → intermediate drivers → observed time-series impact), and writing explanations that are clear, grounded, and useful for downstream model training.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create Forecasting Training Tasks: Given a time-series plot and short description, identify the most important patterns (trend, seasonality, regime changes, outliers, step changes, cyclical behavior, variance shifts) and document them clearly.
  • Write Causal Chains: Produce concise causal narratives that explain patterns from root cause → mechanism → observable time-series effect, prioritizing the most meaningful drivers and avoiding generic explanations.
  • Ensure Clarity & Usefulness for AI Training: Write structured, high-signal explanations that are easy to evaluate, minimizing ambiguity and making assumptions explicit when necessary.
  • Maintain Consistency & Quality: Follow project guidelines and rubrics to ensure outputs are accurate, coherent, and comparable across many examples.
  • Weekly Commitment: 10 hours/week

Your Profile

  • You have an educational and/or professional background in Statistics or a closely related field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science).
  • Proficient in time-series analysis and forecasting (e.g., trend/seasonality, structural breaks, anomalies, volatility shifts, lag effects).
  • Excellent English writing skills with a clear, structured, concise style.
  • Strong analytical judgment and ability to interpret data visualizations with precision.
  • Comfortable forming plausible causal explanations while clearly separating evidence from assumptions.
  • Optional: Domain knowledge in one or more of the following: Healthcare; Climate/oceanography; Economics & finance; Cloud operations; Transportation.

title: Corretor de Imóveis
description:
Maximize seus ganhos com o modelo mais disruptivo do mercado!

Diferentemente das imobiliárias tradicionais, na BR Estate nós não ficamos com uma porcentagem da sua comissão. Nosso foco é oferecer a infraestrutura jurídica e de marketing para que você receba o valor justo pelo seu trabalho.

  • Independência e rateio justo da Comissão: Em todas as transações sempre haverá 2 corretores/imobiliárias diferentes: um representando o vendedor ("Corretor de Venda") e outro representando o comprador ("Corretor de Compra"), cada um ficando com 50% da comissão.
  • Modelo único: Quando ocorre uma venda, descontamos no sucesso a Taxa de Operação, de 0,5% do valor do Imóvel (com valor mínimo de 3 e máximo de 6 salários mínimos); e, a Taxa de Marketing, de R$250,00 por lead qualificado recebido.
  • Venda mais e ganhe indicando imóveis: Ao indicar imóveis à BR Estate, nós direcionamos para você os leads compradores gerados a partir desse imóvel; e, quando esse imóvel for vendido, você ganha metade da comissão do Corretor de Venda.
  • Faça a BR Estate crescer e ganhe mais por isso: O Corretor Associado que indicar outros corretores para se associar à BR Estate, ganha 25% da Taxa de Operação a cada transação dos corretores indicados.
  • Trabalhe com total autonomia! Sem presença obrigatória no escritório. Sem reuniões obrigatórias. Sem volumes obrigatórios de prospecções ou captações. Sem gerentes e diretores. Negociação de descontos a critério exclusivo dos corretores envolvidos. Time de advogados para fechamento das vendas à disposição dos Corretores Associados.

Perguntas e respostas

  • Fechei 3 vendas: um imóvel de R$800K, outro de R$1,6MM e outro de R$2,4MM. Como fica a Taxa de Operação? Se as comissões forem de 5%, no imóvel de R$800.000,00, você ganha R$20.000,00 e deve pagar à BR Estate a taxa de operação no piso de R$4.863,00; no de R$1.600.000, você ganha R$40.000,00 e deve pagar à BR Estate a taxa de operação de R$8.000,00; no de R$2.400.000, você ganha R$60.000,00 e deve pagar à BR Estate a taxa de operação no teto de R$9.726,00;
  • Para a cobrança da Taxa de Marketing, o que é um lead qualificado? Para leads compradores, lead qualificado é o cliente com visita realizada, presencial ou remota (leads enviados por engano, tais como clientes de aluguel, "vender para comprar" e corretores não são cobrados); para leads vendedores, lead qualificado é cliente que tenha o seu imóvel efetivamente publicado no site da BR Estate.
  • Se eu prospectar o cliente, comprador ou vendedor, como funciona? Esse cliente não será contabilizado para a cobrança da Taxa de Marketing.
  • Se meu cliente comprador fechar um imóvel que eu mesmo indiquei à BR Estate? Nesse caso, você ganha a sua comissão como Corretor de Compra, e ainda ganha metade da comissão do Corretor de Venda.
  • Posso fechar uma parceria com outra imobiliária/corretor? Deve! Parcerias são mais que bem vindas e não afetam a cobrança das taxas.
  • Quero anunciar imóveis através da BR Estate, porém sem passar o contato do proprietário. Posso? Sim, porém nesse caso você atuará exclusivamente como Corretor de Venda e não receberá os leads compradores.
  • É obrigatório estar inscrito no CRECI? Sim.
  • A BR Estate exige exclusividade? Não. O pagamento das taxas à BR Estate somente é devido se o lead tiver sido gerado pela BR Estate ou se o corretor da outra parte também for associado à BR Estate.
  • Como funciona o pagamento das Taxas de Operação e Marketing à BR Estate? Elas serão pagas diretamente pelos clientes e abatidas da comissão devida ao Corretor Associado.
  • Qual o escopo da BR Estate no pós-vendas? Elaboração do compromisso de compra e venda, análise das certidões e encaminhamento para o cartório de notas e/ou instituição financeira responsável pela conclusão jurídica do negócio, salvo se os clientes exigirem conduzir o fechamento do negócio com assessores próprios.

Avisos legais:

A associação à BR Estate por ser encerrada a qualquer momento por quaisquer das partes, desde que não haja valores devido em aberto entre elas, e não importa em vínculo societário, empregatício e/ou previdenciário. Os Corretores Associados são responsáveis por atualizar e coletar corretamente as informações dos clientes sob seu atendimento, devendo rejeitar as que sejam sabidamente incorretas, desatualizadas ou obtidas de maneira ilícita. Os Corretores Associados devem emitir as notas fiscais correspondentes à sua parcela da comissão. A BR Estate se reserva ao direito de definir o padrão de qualidade do atendimento que deverá ser seguido pelo Corretor Associado.

title: Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement
description:
Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA Zurich (FZ) Workforce Management team and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement is responsible for creating an unforgettable experience for all Staff at FIFA27 by providing a seamless and professional onboarding, a positive and engaging workplace environment, a rewarding and once in a lifetime Tournament and a simple but thorough offboarding journey.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament by retaining the FIFA27 Workforce and leaving a lasting positive impression so that FIFA continues to be the employer of choice for future Tournaments and events.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into workforce operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage employee engagement/social activities and a communication plan to excite and engage all employees during their time with FIFA27.
  • Develop a strong working relationship with FIFA Zurich communications & engagement teams, and embed central FIFA initiatives and engagement programs into FIFA27.
  • Working closely with the Senior Manager, Recruitment & HR & HRBP’s to:
  • Generate ideas for embedding FIFA27 culture and values into the workplace environment
  • Partner on increasing employee satisfaction by implementing ideas based on employee feedback
  • Lead the workforce communications strategy, including the delivery of an ‘all-staff’ tournament workforce briefing prior to mass arrivals at tournament-time
  • In collaboration with the workforce operations, manage the strategy, planning and execution of a tournament-time workforce reward & recognition program across eight FWWC host cities.
  • Plan and execute the FIFA27 employee offboarding journey
  • Determine and manage the end-to-end onboarding processes from employment contract signature to the end of the new joiners first month, including the delivery of induction days and onboarding content.
  • Identify and manage the requirements and steps for relocation services for employees within Brazil and internationally.
  • Work closely with VISA & Immigration resources to determine processes for entry to Brazil in alignment with immigration requirements for international employees.
  • Establish mechanisms and collate detailed information regarding setting up ‘temporary life in Brazil’ to support international new employees with their relocation and settling into their new life in Brazil and their role with FIFA27.
  • Source, procure and manage distribution of new employee welcome packs in preparation for new joiner’s first day at FIFA27.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 5 years’ experience in a comparable role in an international, fast-paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge and demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Ability to provide examples where excellent client service skills and the capacity to facilitate the needs of multiple business units has served you well in your career to date.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrable adaptability and examples of where you’ve acted as a facilitator and/or negotiator.
  • Strong attention to detail, demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Fluent Portuguese, advanced or fluent English skills (written & spoken)

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Com criatividade, estudos e muitas pesquisas, a Dermage se tornou uma das marcas de dermocosméticos mais queridinhas das brasileiras. Seus produtos, desenvolvidos com ativos de alta eficácia e sem testes em animais, ganharam posição de destaque, com fórmulas premiadas e indicações de dermatologistas.

De uma pequena sala em Copacabana e poucas fórmulas, para mais de 200 produtos no portfólio e mais de 70 lojas no país, entre próprias e franquias, além da distribuição em farmácias e em grandes multimarcas.

Nossa empresa tem como missão cuidar das pessoas, oferecendo saúde e beleza hoje e sempre.

Buscamos um colaborador que goste de inovação, execução e tenha vontade de fazer diferente!

Se você gosta de desafios, queremos conhecer você!

O Analista de Abastecimento será responsável por monitorar, analisar e otimizar os níveis de estoque, garantindo o abastecimento eficiente de produtos em toda a cadeia de suprimentos, de acordo com a demanda e políticas de estoque da empresa. O profissional atuará de forma analítica e estratégica, propondo melhorias nos processos e colaborando com diversas áreas da companhia, como Planejamento, Compras, Comercial e Logística.

Principais atividades:

  • Monitorar níveis de estoque e garantir o abastecimento de produtos conforme demanda e políticas internas;
  • Acompanhar planos de reposição junto aos centros de distribuição e fornecedores;
  • Analisar acuracidade de demanda e propor ajustes nos parâmetros de reposição;
  • Utilizar sistemas ERP para emissão de pedidos, controle logístico e acompanhamento de estoques;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados ao abastecimento;
  • Sugerir melhorias em processos de abastecimento para reduzir rupturas, excessos e aumentar eficiência;
  • Analisar causas de ruptura, sobreposição de estoques e giro por SKU, categoria e loja;
  • Colaborar de forma transversal com Planejamento, Compras, Comercial e Logística;
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações para tomada de decisão estratégica.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Logística, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Excel (será testado);
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas ERP;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI será considerado um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em Supply Chain, Logística, Planejamento de Demanda ou Reposição será um diferencial;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência em abastecimento, planejamento ou gestão de estoques (Empresas de dermocosméticos será um diferencial)
  • Excel avançado ( sera testado)
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, SQL,VBA
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Vale Refeição flexível;

Seja bem-vindo à Dermage, um time apaixonado por inovar, cuidar e transformar.

title: Sales
description:
Sales Manager, Brazil (Remote)

Location : Brazil (Remote)

Cambly is one of the largest online English language platforms in the world, backed by top-tier investors like Bessemer and Benchmark. We help thousands of people improve their English and proudly partner with hundreds of the world’s most prestigious companies to empower their teams with language skills for global success.

We're looking for a highly motivated, organized, and results-driven Sales Manager.

The Role

The Sales Manager is a high-impact role responsible for driving significant sales growth by penetrating and securing business with the accounts in our target market. You are responsible for defining and executing a strategic account plan to drive massive revenue growth. This involves navigating large organizational structures, establishing rapport with executive decision-makers, and aligning internal resources to deliver customized solutions. You must be adept at negotiating enterprise level agreements and driving momentum throughout the lengthy sales cycle.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership : You will manage and coach at least 2 teammates. Your goal is to help them perform well, find new sales opportunities, and meet their daily outreach targets.
  • Strategic Account Management : You will be fully responsible for a specific list of important companies. You will create and use plans to win these accounts through both incoming leads and your own outreach.
  • Building Your Pipeline : You will actively grow your list of potential sales. You will do this by contacting leads yourself, working on marketing campaigns with your SDR (Sales Development Representative), and managing interested customers who contact us.
  • Consultative Selling : Use smart questions and "value-selling" to understand what a client really needs. You will build strong relationships with managers to help increase company revenue through new deals and upgrades.
  • Networking : Attend in-person meetings, events, and conferences to build better relationships with high-level executives.
  • Travel : Might need travelling up to 5% of the time for meetings and events.
  • Team Collaboration : Work closely with our Marketing team to stay aligned.

Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • Native in Portuguese and fully proficient in English (C1/C2 level) for clear business communication.
  • 5+ years of total B2B sales experience, with at least 1+ year of proven success in lead generation .
  • A demonstrable track record of developing greenfield territories and landing net-new logos both in SMB and Enterprise companies.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, maintain, and leverage relationships with senior line-of-business and C-level executives.
  • Possess a true Hunter mentality with solid sales DNA, a proactive entrepreneurial spirit, and an appetite for continual learning within a fast-paced startup environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Prior experience working at a fast-growing startup .
  • Previous experience working in a remote & distributed team .
  • Experience engaging with HR & Learning Development teams .
  • Prior sales experience in the learning, e-learning, HR software, or well-being industry .
  • Professional working proficiency in Spanish .

Skills & Mindset

  • A self-motivated, results-driven, and entrepreneurial spirit with a strong growth mindset.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills ; ability to work autonomously and self-source solutions.
  • Active relationship builder who can collaborate effectively with internal and external teams to consistently improve processes and communication.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and remote team environment .

Some Things You Will Enjoy

  • Financial & Growth : Competitive salary, a fair commission system, and a professional development budget.
  • Health & Well-being : Comprehensive medical and dental insurance coverage. We also provide Life Insurance for added security.
  • Mental Health : Access to Modern Health, offering 6 free coaching and 6 free therapy sessions.
  • Flexibility & Time Off & Rest : Hybrid work. 30 calendar days of mandatory paid time off (eligible after 12 months), ensuring you take the necessary time to recharge.
  • Daily Comfort : Meal voucher (via Flash Card) for daily sustenance.
  • Growth & Culture : An employee-first working culture focused on results and growth, no unnecessary stress or nonsense.
  • Team : A truly global team.
  • Language Benefit : Free access to Cambly so you can improve your language skills.

  • Desenvolver componentes customizados ou soluções de integração entre sistemas Octave e aplicações do cliente.
  • Apoiar a equipe de pré-vendas em apresentações técnicas e provas de conceito.
  • Ter boa comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas, administrativas e jurídicas do cliente.

  • Modalidade híbrida no Rio de Janeiro – atuação remota com disponibilidade para comparecer ao cliente conforme necessidade.
  • Formação superior em Engenharia de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência com sistemas de chamados (Salesforce, ServiceNow).
  • Atendimento ao usuário final com foco em excelência de serviço.
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais (ex: SQL Server) e não-relacionais (ex: Redis).

  • Conhecimentos em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux.

About Octave

Octave provides mission-critical software that empowers organizations to make informed decisions across every stage of the asset lifecycle - Design, Build, Operate and Protect - where performance, safety, and reliability are non-negotiable and failure is not an option. Turning complex operational data into actionable intelligence, Octave connects expertise, real-world conditions and enterprise-scale insight to improve performance, resilience and incident response where it matters most. Octave has more than 7,000 employees in 45 countries. Learn more at octave.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

Why work for Octave?

All in. Always forward. That's the way we do things around here. We put trust in our people because we believe it's the best way to unleash potential, bring ideas to life, and keep moving ahead. And it's why we're committed to creating an environment that's truly supportive, providing you with the resources you need to support your ambitions, no matter who you are or where you are in the world.

Everyone is welcome

At Octave, we believe that diverse and inclusive teams are critical to the success of our people and our business. Here, everyone is welcome. As an inclusive workplace, we don't discriminate. In fact, we embrace differences and are fully committed to creating equal opportunities, an inclusive environment, and fairness for all. Respect is the cornerstone of how we operate, so speak up and be yourself. You're valued here.

Como Auxiliar de Infraetrutura, você atuará na Splice Indústria na base do Rio de Janeiro.

Executa a infraestrutura em vias urbana, vias públicas, ruas e avenidas para executar o corte do asfalto para instala dos “laços” sensor de velocidade. Essas atividades consistem em cortar o asfalto com o auxílio de uma máquina de corte (serra clipper). This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a reliability/rotating equipment engineer to join the North Ghawar Maintenance Division (NGMD) / Reliability Unit (RU) of the North Ghawar Producing Department (NGPD).

The RU's scope includes condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis to identify and mitigate potential equipment failures. By leveraging these services, the RU aims to optimize rotating equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and improve overall asset efficiency.

Your primary role is to provide proactive maintenance support, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, and overseeing rotating equipment overhaul activities to ensure optimal equipment performance and minimize downtime.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Oversee and perform Product Data Management (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, to identify potential equipment failures and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop and implement condition-based maintenance programs to optimize equipment performance and minimize downtime.
  • Develop and implement reliability-centered maintenance programs to identify and prioritize maintenance activities based on equipment reliability and criticality.
  • Perform failure analysis on equipment to identify root causes of failures and recommend corrective actions to prevent repeat failures.
  • Perform technical evaluations of new equipment to ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, and to identify potential reliability and maintenance issues.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, such as American Petroleum Institute (API), American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), and American Society for Testing and Materials ASTM, for rotating equipment and reliability engineering.
  • Prepare technical reports and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including management and operations teams.
  • Perform oil analysis and other predictive maintenance tests to identify potential equipment problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Perform diagnostics on rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, and gearboxes, to identify potential problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain Reliability Unit KPIs such as maintenance cost reduction, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR).

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Have a minimum of 15 years of experience in reliability/rotating equipment engineering.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of reliability, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, and condition-based maintenance.
  • Familiarity with rotating equipment diagnostics such as vibration analysis, oil analysis, and non‑destructive testing methods.
  • Hold a vibration analyst certificate Cat‑III.
  • Understand industry standards and codes related to reliability, such as API, ASME, and ASTM.
  • Practical experience in reliability engineering or a related field, preferably in the oil and gas industry.
  • Effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness of the latest advancements in reliability science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.
  • Knowledge of rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Experience with Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis.
  • Familiarity with condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis.
  • Ability to perform and aid in technical evaluations of new equipment.

title: Research Geophysicist
description:
Posting Start Date: 3/13/26

Field of Work: Geoscience / Geophysics

TGS provides scientific data and intelligence to the global energy sector, enabling energy for all by unlocking vital, data‑driven solutions and knowledge. Through an extensive and diverse energy data library, advanced analytics, cloud‑based applications, and specialized services, we work in a way that is Passionate, Results‑Driven, Collaborative, and Responsible.

Serves as a Research Geophysicist within the Rio de Janeiro R&D team, focusing on the acceleration and automation of the seismic processing lifecycle. This role is a key technical bridge, working in daily collaboration with Data Scientists to find the right blend of conventional signal processing and physics‑based techniques with integrating geophysical first principles into AI‑driven workflows. The primary objective is to develop and implement innovative algorithms for seismic processing that significantly reduce turnaround time while maintaining or enhancing the rigorous standards of geophysical QC.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and refine geophysical algorithms with a specific focus on automation.
  • Partner closely with Data Scientists to design ML and hybrid workflows that combine traditional signal‑processing and physics‑based techniques with ML‑based solvers.
  • Design automated, objective QC metrics that leverage geophysical attributes to validate the integrity of AI‑processed data.
  • Identify bottlenecks in traditional processing sequences and propose accelerated alternatives using high‑performance computing (HPC) or GPU‑optimized kernels.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, domain experts, and cross‑functional teams on framing ML based solutions.
  • Support the translation of research ideas into scalable production solutions and workflows.
  • Participate in external research activities, publications, or technical forums.
  • Seismic Theory: Deep understanding of wave propagation, signal processing (F‑K, Tau‑P, Curvelet), and inversion theory.
  • Processing Fluency: Hands‑on experience with the seismic processing sequence (from field tapes to migration) and an understanding of where “human‑in‑the‑loop” delays occur.
  • Technical Collaboration: Works effectively within multi‑lead, interdisciplinary environments.
  • Professional Maturity: Operates independently on complex technical problems while seeking alignment when appropriate.

Qualifications:

  • PhD (or MSc with strong applied or research experience) in Geophysics, Physics or a related field.
  • Demonstrated expertise in seismic processing through research, applied projects, or open‑source contributions.
  • Strong programing skills with proficiency in Python is required; experience with C++ for performance‑critical seismic kernels is a significant advantage.
  • Communication: Ability to communicate complex geophysical concepts to non‑geophysicists (data scientists and software engineers), as well as explaining new ideas to processing geophysicists and customers.

If you meet the qualifications and are passionate about contributing to our team, we encourage you to submit your application by04/13/2026.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Data Science AI Trainer, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design original computational data science problems that simulate real-world analytical workflows across industries (telecom, finance, government, e-commerce, healthcare)
  • Create problems requiring Python programming to solve (using pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn)
  • Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks)
  • Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains in data processing, statistical analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and insight extraction
  • Create deterministic problems with reproducible answers: avoid stochastic elements or require fixed random seeds for exact reproducibility
  • Base problems on real business challenges: customer analytics, risk assessment, fraud detection, forecasting, optimization, and operational efficiency
  • Design end-to-end problems spanning the complete data science pipeline (data ingestion → cleaning → EDA → modeling → validation → deployment considerations)
  • Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches

  • Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers.

Compensation

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You hold a Master's or PhD Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.

  • You have portfolio of completed projects and publications showcasing real-world problem‑solving.

  • You have good understanding of MLOps practices and model deployment workflows
  • You possess knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain)
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio

title: Global Head of Cloud Alliances
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go‑to‑market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell‑to, sell‑through and sell‑with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud‑related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

Role Entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical’s global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross‑functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive‑level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long‑term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What We Are Looking For In You

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above‑and‑beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data‑driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in‑depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to Have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What We Offer Colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Resumo do Perfil do Cargo

The Fiscal Compliance Supervisor leads and oversees all tax and fiscal compliance activities for Brazil Operations. Responsibilities include reviewing tax calculations and ensuring the timely submission of all required declarations at the federal, state, and municipal levels, as well as filings with BACEN, IBGE, and other regulatory or statistical entities. This role safeguards full compliance, maintains good standing certifications, and ensures adherence to applicable legislation, special tax or customs regimes, and customer contract requirements. The position partners closely with Management and Statutory Accounting, Corporate Tax, Treasury, Intercompany, Supply Chain (Logistics and Procurement), and HR (Payroll and Employment Tax) to ensure accurate tax treatment and compliance across key processes, including equipment movement, payroll burdens, and PIT (IRRF) obligations. The role also manages outsourced service providers, supports audits and inspections, and leads the local fiscal compliance sub team in applying best practices and meeting all statutory deadlines.

Descrição do Cargo

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Tax & Fiscal Compliance Execution - Review and validate federal, state, and municipal tax calculations (IRPJ/CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, IBS, CBS, IS, IPTU, etc.). Ensure the timely submission of all statutory declarations (SPEDs, DCTF, EFDs, DIRF equivalent filings, municipal returns, and nota fiscal issuance/collection). Coordinate regulatory filings with the IRS, BACEN, IBGE, and other government or statistical entities. Maintain full compliance with legislation, special tax or customs regimes (e.g., REPETRO and specific ICMS treatments), and customer contract obligations.
  • Cross Functional Compliance Support - Partner with Supply Chain to ensure compliant equipment, goods, and asset movement, including ICMS compliance, nota fiscal issuance, and proper supporting documentation. Support HR in payroll tax compliance, including social burdens (INSS and FGTS) and PIT/IRRF obligations. Collaborate with Management and Statutory Accounting teams on tax accounting in corporate and local ledgers, including P&L provisioning and actuals, balance sheet reconciliations, and budget/forecast preparation for General Taxes. Work with Corporate Tax, Treasury, Legal and Intercompany teams to ensure correct tax treatment across all business processes.
  • Governance, Controls & Risk Management - Maintain internal controls related to fiscal compliance and tax reporting. Monitor regulatory changes and ensure timely adjustments to internal processes. Participate in Tax Committees (Tax Reform, Optimization/Savings Projects, ABESPETRO). Safeguard good standing certifications and adherence to compliance requirements across all regulatory bodies.
  • Audit, Inspection & Authority Liaison - Manage responses to tax audits, fiscal inspections, official notices, and inquiries from authorities at all government levels. Coordinate documentation, supporting analyses, and interactions with external auditors and tax advisors.
  • Team Leadership & Vendor Oversight - Lead, mentor, and develop the Brazil fiscal compliance sub team. Oversee outsourced compliance and advisory service providers to ensure proper fiscal documentation (e.g., nota fiscal) retrieval, accuracy, quality, and adherence to cut off dates and tax calendar deadlines. Promote best practices, operational excellence, and continuous process improvement. Recruit, coach, and develop assigned personnel.
  • Perform miscellaneous tasks as required, including the preparation of slide presentations for senior management and other stakeholders' reviews.

Education

  • Minimum Required: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Law, or related field.
  • Preferred Level: Bachelor’s degree with Post‑Graduate specialization or MBA in Taxation, Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.

Experience

  • Minimum Required: 5+ years of experience in fiscal compliance and accounting operations within Brazil, including routine tax reporting, statutory filings, and tax accounting responsibilities. Demonstrated experience in cross‑functional collaboration.
  • Preferred Level: Supervisory experience in a multi‑entity or multi‑country financial reporting environment, with exposure to corporate‑level tax, treasury, and compliance processes.

Skills

  • Minimum Required: Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; solid bookkeeping foundation; working knowledge of US GAAP/IFRS and Brazilian statutory accounting requirements; strong understanding of local fiscal and tax compliance rules. Must be proficient in written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Preferred Level: Hands‑on experience in full fiscal compliance preparation; advanced Excel skills; familiarity with ERP systems and tax compliance solutions; strong analytical and documentation abilities.

title: Principal Electrical Engineer
description:
Job Overview

Do you like working in collaborative cross‑functional global teams to solve technical problems?

Would you like to work with cutting‑edge downhole technology?

Join our Downhole Services team

Our Downhole services Team provides industry‑leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production, and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity.

Partner with the best

Principal Engineer

As a Principal Engineer, you will support development through individual and teamwork. The qualified candidate will lead efforts on assigned task from concept requirement to validation testing and commercial release. The position may also include opportunities for leadership responsibilities in a team of early and mid‑career engineers.

Product Management Specialist

Driving Product Excellence Through Structured Design, Cost Transparency & Operational Readiness

Do you enjoy building strong product foundations that enable commercial and operational success? Partner with the best. Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

Fuel your passion

As a Product Management Specialist, you will play a critical role in supporting, structuring, and optimizing our product portfolios structure. You will be responsible for developing product configurations, cost frameworks, and manufacturing readiness plans that ensure consistent, high‑quality delivery across the business. Working closely with engineering, manufacturing, commercial, and supply chain teams, you will drive the successful implementation of new products (NPI) and continuous improvement across our product lines.

As a Product Management Specialist, you will be responsible for:

  • Owning product structuring across the premium casing portfolio, ensuring clear and scalable configurations that support manufacturing, costing, and commercial needs.
  • Developing and maintaining cost handbooks that provide transparent, data‑driven cost models for quoting, product decisions, and long‑term margin management.
  • Leading NPI implementation with manufacturing teams, ensuring new designs are production‑ready, cost‑optimized, and aligned with operational capabilities.
  • Partnering with engineering, supply chain, and commercial teams to define product requirements, manage changes, and support product rationalization.
  • Conducting technical and commercial reviews to recommend improvements in design, manufacturability, cost, and operational performance.
  • Supporting customer‑facing teams with product expertise, structured documentation, and technical insights.
  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen product quality, reduce cost, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Ensuring alignment with product governance standards, documentation requirements, and lifecycle management processes.

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Have experience in product and project management, engineering, or manufacturing within oilfield equipment, tubulars, or related products.
  • Have 5+ years of experience in product development, operations, or engineering roles.
  • Have strong analytical capabilities with a focus on cost modeling, product structuring, and process optimization.
  • Have a solid understanding of manufacturing processes and design‑for‑manufacturing principles.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across global cross‑functional teams and engaging with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Have strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical topics.
  • Have experience supporting or leading NPI programs.

Work Flexibility

Our role offers flexible working patterns, including:

  • Flexible hours tailored to individual productivity and work‑life needs.
  • Opportunities for hybrid working where applicable.

Company Culture & Benefits

  • Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Services Specialist - Project Management

About Us

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Assessorar tecnicamente e prestar suporte às áreas da CASSI, quanto a assuntos referentes a conceitos, normas/ operacionalização de sistemas relacionados à sua área de atuação, visando consolidar informações e manter a qualidade dos serviços prestados.
  • Planejar e executar ações de capacitação e treinamentos de pessoal, organizar encontros visando a padronização dos critérios.
  • Participar do planejamento, divulgação, execução e avaliação das atividades de educação em saúde.
  • Manter-se atualizado e assegurar o cumprimento da legislação, dos atos regulatórios e dos princípios éticos que regem o exercício da enfermagem.
  • Acolher o participante, proporcionando atendimento humanizado, identificando as necessidades de intervenções de cuidado, responsabilizando-se pela continuidade da atenção e viabilizando o estabelecimento do vínculo.

  • Planejar e executar ações de saúde para os participantes do território, seguindo diretrizes da Sede, visando à qualidade da atenção e a racionalização dos recursos.
  • Realizar as ações e os procedimentos previstos, dispostos na “Carteira de Ações e Procedimentos da Atenção Primária à Saúde” de acordo com a sua área de atuação.
  • Planejar, gerenciar, coordenar, executar e avaliar as atividades de enfermagem da Atenção Primária a Saúde.
  • Executar a sistematização da assistência de enfermagem, por meio da consulta de enfermagem e realização de procedimentos.

  • Avaliar a solicitação de administração de medicamento por prescrição médica emitida externamente ao serviço de APS.
  • Realizar interconsultas, seguindo protocolos e diretrizes, com vistas a potencializar a resolutividade da APS e contribuir para uma assistência integral.

  • Colaborar com o planejamento e execução de programas de saúde, no âmbito da APS, seguindo as diretrizes da Sede, elaborando estratégias de intervenção individual ou familiar, visando à qualidade das ações programáticas de saúde.
  • Emitir laudos, relatórios e pareceres técnicos, dentro dos normativos da entidade a fim de responder uma demanda específica do participante.
  • Registrar em prontuário eletrônico os dados assistenciais provenientes das interações com o participante, contribuindo para a sua coordenação de cuidados e para o conhecimento do perfil epidemiológico da população.
  • Promover, organizar e executar atividades de educação permanente da equipe da APS, visando o aprimoramento técnico da equipe e a qualidade no cuidado.
  • Participar ativamente das ações que envolvam o compartilhamento do cuidado com outros pontos de atenção da Rede de Atenção Integral à Saúde - RAIS, em tempo oportuno e de maneira adequada, quando da necessidade de acompanhamento e/ou intervenção de especialista para cuidado integral do participante, mantendo a coordenação de cuidados.

title: Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representatives, Managers, and Directors to expand our reach in mission‑critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as consumer electronics. We are looking for candidates who are technically skilled and familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS. We are expanding in all time zones, so we can accommodate candidates from almost any country as long as they have reasonable business access to a substantial market territory in person. As we grow our teams, we will also hire Sales Team Managers and Regional Sales Directors. Please continue with this process if your goal is a management leadership position.

The server edition of Ubuntu is already very widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high‑end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics, as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management, and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real‑time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint.

This is a prospecting sales and strategic account development role and requires energy, ambition, and focus. To be successful, you must be comfortable positioning and selling open source, services, and software solutions to all levels of an organization, and specifically to departments that are developing embedded software and IoT devices. You should also be familiar with at least one of our priority sectors.

Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute, and every category of application. Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting, and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote, and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position; it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long‑term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision‑making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long‑term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world‑leading company, we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment that promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration, and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry‑specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted, which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with brands in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement, and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgment as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete, and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies, and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location

We are growing our sales reach in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas.

The role entails

  • Building and executing a territory plan to prioritize leading security‑focused brands and manufacturers
  • Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
  • Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Closing contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
  • Managing customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Working with IoT Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
  • Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision‑makers
  • Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above‑and‑beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
  • Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
  • Ability to develop and execute territory sales plans
  • Detail oriented with effective follow‑up

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Under general supervision, the Part-Time Clinical Research Trials Pharmacist is responsible for interpretation of physician's orders, review of patient therapy, dispensing of appropriate ordered medications and performs all operational duties and evaluations necessary within the inpatient and satellite services.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

Interacts in a clinical trial capacity with patients, physicians, other allied health care providers, social services representatives, other immediate clinical staff members, Hospital and University officials and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Interprets medication order for appropriateness of therapy, drug, dose, route, frequency, and duration. Consults with prescriber when clarification is required or makes appropriate therapy and other recommendations as needed.
  • Manages required record-keeping, Investigational Products (IP) study logs, and inventory activities.
  • Oversees administrative accountability associated with the clinical research trials.
  • Maintains records to meet sponsor requirements, FDA regulations and legal requirements for pharmacy operations.
  • Ensures that the prescribed order follows the protocol treatment plan and HUH standard policies and procedures and consults with the principal investigator, co-investigators, and/or research nurses when clarification is required.
  • Reviews orders for investigational agents to ensure that necessary dosage adjustments are made according to the protocol.
  • Monitors patient laboratory indices to ensure conformity with protocol requirements prior to dispensing medications/investigational agents.
  • Reviews patient medication profile for possible drug reactions, duplication of orders and contraindications and consults with physician when clarification is required.
  • Enters patient's medication orders in the standardized pharmacy computer program according to the approved departmental procedures.
  • Ensures that informed consent signed by the subject is on file prior to dispensing medications/investigational agents as required by 21 CFR 50.27.
  • Ensures that accountability records, dispensing documentation, and inventory for all investigational agents are accurate.
  • Progressively monitors inventory level and expiry date and re-order, as necessary.
  • Participates in the preparation of investigational protocol dispensing procedures, drug data sheets, IV worksheets, and physician order forms.
  • Participates in investigational study site visit activities such as audits, pre-qualification visits, site initiation meetings, routine monitoring visits, and site closure visits as applicable.
  • Performs supervision of supportive staff in compounding all parenteral admixtures according to established departmental procedures. Provides directions and guidance in appropriate manners.
  • Performs double checks of supportive staff in compounding of parenteral admixtures, preparation of oral drugs, receipts, and destructions of Investigational Products (IPs), and code carts and hypersensitivity kits.
  • Ensures that proper drug solutions/diluents and volumes are used during drug preparations, and that final products are labeled, and packaged correctly for subjects participating in research protocols.
  • Contributes to clinical trial electronic data capture (EDC) for adverse drug reaction and medication occurrences reporting system.
  • Utilizes computerized controlled drug system in the preparation and distribution of scheduled drugs and complies with all associated record keeping and inventory requirements by DEA.
  • Participates in clinical and quality improvement activities and/or projects within the department and with medical and nursing staff as needed.
  • Participates in general pharmacy meetings, monthly research meetings, pharmacy safety meetings, journal clubs, continuing education presentations, and/or in-services to ensure competency in pharmacy.
  • Understands and able to perform all the essential functions of the research pharmacy technician to ensure the continual operation of the research pharmacy.
  • Sustains professional competence by completing all competence / skills assessment requirements; promotes development through participation in in-services, workshops, seminars, and professional organizations.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are appropriate to the position and area. The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and the natures of the work assigned to this classification and are not to be considered as all inclusive.

Special Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Good communication skills; ability to provide direction to others; ability to work under stress. Ability to perform computerized procedures. Must demonstrate and maintain current knowledge and skills in providing appropriate care for patients in the following age groups, geriatric, adult, adolescent, pediatric, and neonate. Must demonstrate knowledge in the relationship of age and the proper selection of drugs and drug pharmacokinetics in various age groups. Annual performance appraisals will measure the level of knowledge and skills maintained through the use of criteria-based job standards. Employees must maintain a satisfactory level of knowledge and skills to continue employment.

Education And/Or Training Required

Graduate of an accredited School of Pharmacy.

Licensure And/Or Certification

Current D.C. license as a pharmacist.

Vaccination and Immunization Authority Certification

Certified in vaccination and immunization authority.

Experience

Two years as a pharmacist in a hospital setting or an outpatient setting. Experience with clinical trials preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$63-$70 per hour

Sólida compreensão dos sistemas de Qualidade, processos e ferramentas da área, com habilidade para apoiar colegas e resolver problemas de forma eficaz.

  • Ministrar aulas de Dança alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Dança;
  • Experiência com infantil;
  • Inglês fluente para ministrar as aulas nesse idioma.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Se você quer conquistar os melhores resultados com pessoas que sonham grande, trabalham e crescem juntos(as), nossa área corporativa é o seu lugar.

Para transformar a saúde é preciso:

  • Conhecimento em protocolos de segurança do paciente e rotinas hospitalares;
  • Habilidade para liderança, tomada de decisão e gestão de conflitos;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Nosso cuidado começa dentro de casa, entregando o melhor para as nossas pessoas.

Na Rede Américas, valorizamos quem constrói o cuidado no dia a dia. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios pensados para o seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.

WHY JOIN US

MUST HAVES

  • Familiarity with survey analytics (e.g., pulse surveys, eNPS) and combining behavioral and attitudinal data;
  • Exposure to analytics for employee communications platforms (e.g., intranet, email platforms, internal messaging tools);
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience designing advanced data visualizations in Tableau;
  • Experience with Python for exploratory analysis or data manipulation.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
